finding: GDM subtypes effectively stratified maternal and perinatal risks, with the GDM-Mixed subtype increasing the risk of cesarean delivery, LGA, and type 2 diabetes postpartum, while GDM-Sensitivity increased the risk of preterm birth and prediabetes postpartum.
mod_finding: The GDM-Mixed subtype had a higher rate of cesarean delivery (63.3%) compared to the overall GDM group (55.6%).
